summary: The two requested corrections are now explicit and implementation-ready. session.remove requires authoritative SDK descendant checks before confirmation and immediately before removal, exhausts pagination including empty pages with a next cursor, fails closed on malformed pages, repeated or invalid cursors, read failures and the bounded page limit, and permits absence proof only through the installed typed SessionNotFoundError or an exhaustive validated list scan. Lifecycle receipts now distinguish known success, known failure or cancellation, in-flight and unknown states; an exact duplicate of UNKNOWN\_OUTCOME returns fixed UNKNOWN\_OUTCOME without replay or false success. The corrections address the prior blocking findings without broadening the stated product, architecture, security or stored-data boundary.
